policy.selection: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
policy.fits: Fresh production controls on all 18 additional photos; share a fit only for identical source/crop/settings. Fresh-fit each neural addition. On the original 32 photos, reuse pinned production controls and freshly fit each neural crop for this fixed policy.
policy.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
policy.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.

modelChoice: Existing 16-photo, 120-update decoder model already tested through real browser WASM. Fixed model; no choice based on the expanded photos.
sequence: Audit expanded source separation, fixed complete selection and unchanged checkpoint.
Infer all 18 original photos natively and inspect all predictions.
Recheck the combined continuous-palette/outer-sampling policy on all original 32 browser fields, retaining all original successful cases.
Run fresh production and NN-fallback pipelines on all 18 photos, including unresolved and failed cases.
Reuse the exact ONNX graph; verify new original-photo browser inputs and outputs, then downstream crop and editable-template behavior.
Evaluate browser loading, failure handling and end-user integration before production promotion.

numericalAssessment.originalThresholdParity: Exact >0.5 mask agreement; failures remain failures.
numericalAssessment.functionalAssessment: Record crop-support/selection agreement and corner movement separately from raw numerical gates. Do not relabel failed raw parity as passed. No new release tolerance is selected from these outcomes.

scope: Expanded development evaluation, not untouched holdout or independent motif proof. Compare one fixed NN/crop policy with production. No claim of better template quality from training metrics or lower error against a changed target.
